name: Harley-Davidson Knucklehead
engine: 61 or 74 cubic inch air-cooled OHV V-twin, single carb, total-loss or early recirculating oiling, magneto or points
intro: Harley's first overhead-valve big twin. A collector bike. Originality and correct parts matter as much as getting it running.

add.title: Record the engine and frame numbers
add.instructions: Photograph and write down the engine case number and any frame numbers. Compare them to known numbering before you buy parts or value the bike.
add.reason: Matching, original numbers make a big difference on a Knucklehead.

G: Most Knuckleheads use a Linkert carb. Get the right rebuild kit for the model number on the carb.
F: Many early bikes run 6-volt electrics. Check before you buy bulbs or a battery.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
